info.description: The Audit Management API allows businesses to register and manage audits by their unique identifiers. This endpoint specifically facilitates the creation of audit records, ensuring that all relevant data is captured and tracked accurately. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and compliance teams looking to maintain thorough audit trails. The API supports integrations with existing systems to streamline audit workflows and enhance regulatory reporting capabilities.
